name: 31488-jsonschema-eagle3-8b-1gpu
model: Target NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- an ungated byte re-upload of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct; the Llama 3.1 Community License applies. Draft lmsys/sglang-EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B, the head trained against that target.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism -- one target model, one draft model, one scheduler.
architecture: Target LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, 16.1 GB bf16. Draft LlamaForCausalLMEagle3, one layer, draft_vocab_size 32000, max_position_embeddings 2048.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=24, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 600 requests with a 2400 s safety cap. 24 sits inside the 64-request admission ceiling.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `/v1/chat/completions`, single turn, no shared prefix: prompts centred on 256 tokens (stdev 64, clamped 128-384), seed 42, temperature 0. Every request carries the JSON-schema `response_format` declared once in `scenario.json` under `backend.extras.body` -- a 60-element array of `{id, label, score}` objects -- and that schema, not a token cap, is what fixes output length at ~1300 tokens. `synthetic_text.output_tokens` is deliberately not declared, because guidellm then sets `ignore_eos: True`, which a grammar cannot run under; `ignore_eos: false` is pinned in `extras.body` as well, and `backend.max_tokens: 2048` is a runaway guard that is not expected to bind.
purpose: A structured catalogue tagger emitting schema-bound JSON records from short prompts for 24 concurrent users on one GPU, with a draft model.
launch:
# The engine's command line. One H100, EAGLE3 speculative decoding on Llama-3.1-8B, serving
# JSON-schema-constrained chat completions.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE3
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 5
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 6

# float16, not the target's native bfloat16: the draft head ships at float16 and one dtype covers
# target and draft both.
dtype: float16

# The draft head has 2048 positions, and the engine hands it the target's context length and
# refuses to start when that is longer, so the target runs at 2048. A request tops out near
# 1.7k tokens (a prompt of at most 384 plus the ~1.3k-token schema-forced answer). The 2048-token
# completion cap in scenario.json no longer fits beside a prompt; with auto-truncate the engine
# clamps each request's cap to the positions left instead of refusing the request.
context-length: 2048
allow-auto-truncate: true

grammar-backend: xgrammar

page-size: 1
mem-fraction-static: 0.75

# NOT OPTIONAL: the speculative arg group silently resets max_running_requests to 48 when it is
# unset, so the declared admission ceiling would not be the one that runs.
max-running-requests: 64
